text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa declared before reporters 
that people need hope. She would prove her 
strength in the Classic Triple Crown and 
show them hope for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reporters say she doesn't know her 
place. That she isn't built like El Condor 
Pasa, who soared across the world. But—her 
resolve remains unshaken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if they say it's impossible, along 
the Triple Crown trail— I will show them 
hope in the Japanese Derby. Because I've 
already decided that I will.
